changes: ZeroIndexer broadcasting is enabled by default. Manage it in Security & Privacy; sync keeps your selected RPC.
Verify recovery phrase backups, with reminders for existing wallets and backup checks before removing a wallet.
Fixed recovery phrase handling during wallet creation and import, and made backup prompts identify the wallet.
Fixed unlock failures after duplicate wallet removal and prevented deleted wallets from reappearing.
Preserved hardware wallet names during import and credentials when setup cannot finish.
Recovered missing confirmed Zcash transactions in Activity and corrected stale transaction statuses.
Added mainnet compact-block CDN support and another Singapore RPC endpoint.
Fixed sync errors with RPC servers that return an empty successful response.
Import Ledger accounts and sign over USB or Bluetooth with configurable account indexes.
View, rotate, and reuse cached shielded receiving addresses from Receive and Addresses.
Choose an exact wallet birthday date for faster, more precise restores and rescans.
Pending funds stay separate from Available and Max while eligible manual transfers remain usable.
Send warns about CEX shielded-deposit support; Swap verifies external-chain token and network details.
Cross-chain progress now refreshes reliably after reopening Swap or changing accounts.
Fixed explicit sends, TEX Max availability, and unnecessary full wallet rescans.
Improved automatic RPC selection, service error messages, and privacy-safe diagnostic logs.
See wallet updates and promotions directly from the Home screen.
New installations now open Noir Wallet in Chrome's side panel by default.
Open Noir Wallet's GitHub, X, and Telegram links from Settings or About.
Normal sync now recovers transparent change created by dApp transactions.
Spent TEX temporary outputs no longer reappear in balances or prevent transparent funds from being shielded.
New wallets automatically start with the fastest available Zcash RPC connection.
Your selected RPC stays first priority, with automatic fallback when it becomes unavailable.
Added a Singapore RPC endpoint and improved endpoint health checks.
Send ZEC to TEX addresses with either funding source and track every step of the transfer.
Supply, Swap, Withdraw, and Claim show clearer progress while cross-chain settlement completes.
Open Lending in the zkNoir app with all wallet accounts connected automatically.
Activity history now stays complete after a shielded receiving address is rotated.
Spent TEX temporary outputs no longer reappear as transparent balance after transaction expiry.
Privacy controls clear stale Chrome permissions and let you disable Google Analytics independently.
Mainnet sync tries your preferred RPC first and automatically falls back to four alternatives.
In-progress transactions now appear yellow, completed transfers green, and failed transfers red.
Removed unnecessary browsing history and clipboard-reading permissions while keeping wallet notifications.
Background syncing pauses while the wallet is closed unless a transaction still needs monitoring.
Added another mainnet RPC backup after the existing ChainSafe fallback.
Updated the support contact shown in the wallet terms and privacy documentation.
Open Noir Wallet from a popup or Chrome side panel, with Settings now available from Home.
Update reminders now focus on important releases, without another notification after installation.
Improved Lending reliability when a market data service is temporarily unavailable.
Fixed transactions failing to build after reopening or restoring a synced wallet.
Balances now refresh in the background after dApp activity, without opening the wallet to sync manually.
More reliable wallet syncing with automatic recovery when a Zcash connection is unavailable.
Lending prices now stay aligned with RHEA’s latest market data.
Update notifications are less intrusive and open release notes only when you choose to view them.
Control anonymous analytics in Security & Privacy, with clearer disclosure of data never collected.
Track incoming and internal transfers, use transparent ZEC in dApps, and improve Shield actions and history.
Improved dApp and cross-chain recovery, added legacy Orchard privacy guidance, and other wallet fixes.
Keep Sent and Received activity in sync for the same wallet-created transaction.
Hide Shield Funds until transparent funds are confirmed and available.
Improved dApp request reliability when Chrome returns an empty or mismatched wallet response.
Control anonymous analytics from the new Security & Privacy settings.
Track incoming funds as they confirm and become spendable.
Use transparent ZEC balances for supported dApp transactions.
Fixed Shield history amounts to match the transparent funds actually used.
Improved wallet import checks and transaction status reliability.
Privacy guidance for wallets that still hold legacy Orchard funds.
